title: Wedge Sampling: Efficient Tensor Completion with Nearly-Linear Sample Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2602.05869v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce wedge sampling, a non-adaptive sampling scheme for recovering an order-$k$ low-rank tensor of side length $n$ from structured observations of its entries. The scheme samples pairs of entries in the same column of a tensor unfolding, forming length-two paths (wedges) in the associated bipartite sampling graph. The products of the paired entries supply the row correlations needed for spectral initialization in regimes where uniform sampling yields too few wedges. For fixed rank, incoherence, tensor order, and condition number, wedge sampling enables polynomial-time recovery with nearly linear sample complexity in $n$. The spectral initializer can be combined with existing refinement procedures using only an additional $\tilde O(n)$ uniformly sampled entries. translated_title: 楔形采样：具有近线性样本复杂度的高效张量补全
translated_abstract: 我们提出了楔形采样（wedge sampling），这是一种非自适应采样方案，用于从张量元素的结构化观测中恢复阶数为 k、边长为 n 的低秩张量。该方案在张量展开矩阵的同一列中对元素进行成对采样，从而在相关的二部采样图中形成长度为二的路径（即楔形）。在均匀采样产生楔形数量不足的情形下，成对元素的乘积为谱初始化提供了所需的行相关性。在秩、不相干性、张量阶数和条件数均为固定的情况下，楔形采样能够以关于 n 近似线性的样本复杂度实现多项式时间的恢复。该谱初始化器可与现有的精细化程序结合，仅需额外使用 Õ(n) 个均匀采样的元素。谱精细化过程可实现到任意固定相对 Frobenius 误差的弱恢复。对于具有不相干典型多分解（CP）因子的对称三阶张量，……
tldr: 本文提出“楔形采样”这一非自适应采样方案，通过对张量展开同列元素进行成对采样以提供谱初始化所需的行相关性，从而在固定秩条件下以近线性样本复杂度实现低秩张量的多项式时间恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces wedge sampling, a non-adaptive scheme that samples pairs of entries in the same column of tensor unfoldings to supply row correlations for spectral initialization, enabling polynomial-time recovery of low-rank tensors with nearly-linear sample complexity under fixed rank.
